title: Qatl darya pe alamdar huwa
body:
Qatl darya pe alamdar huwa
Asman dekh raha tha, sakka koyi faraat pe aye tha tashnalab, mashkiza bhar ke jaanibe khayma chala wo jab, barse wo teer chidgayi mashk-e-sakina jab, roya alam faraat wafa mashk aur sab.
Gunji maktal mei shah-e-deen ki sada
(Qatl darya pe alamdar huwa) x2 Aur pyaaso ki ye aas tut gayi, Aya maktal se alam khun me bhara
<<MINI>>
(Aur pyaaso ki ye aas tut gayi) x2 Qatl darya pe alamdar huwa (Aur pyaaso ki ye aas tut gayi) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Din dhala sham-e-ghariban ke andhere chaaye) x2 bas Sakina ne yahi roke kaha
<<MINI>>
(Aur pyaaso ki ye aas tut gayi) x2 Qatl darya pe alamdar huwa (Aur pyaaso ki ye aas tut gayi) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Ab mere sar se ridaa jayengi zainab ne kaha) x2 Rodiye sar ke shah-e-karbobala
<<MINI>>
(Aur pyaaso ki ye aas tut gayi) x2 Qatl darya pe alamdar huwa (Aur pyaaso ki ye aas tut gayi) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Tere ammu to teri pyaas pe kurbaan huwe) x2 sheh ne ye bali sakina se kaha
<<MINI>>
(Aur pyaaso ki ye aas tut gayi) x2 Qatl darya pe alamdar huwa (Aur pyaaso ki ye aas tut gayi) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Haath mei sukhe huwe kuze liye bethe the) x2 Marsiya pyaas ka maula se suna
<<MINI>>
(Aur pyaaso ki ye aas tut gayi) x2 Qatl darya pe alamdar huwa (Aur pyaaso ki ye aas tut gayi) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Khun-e-abbas jo parcham se tapakte dekha) x2 Dukhtar-e-shah ka dil dub gaya
<<MINI>>
(Aur pyaaso ki ye aas tut gayi) x2 Qatl darya pe alamdar huwa (Aur pyaaso ki ye aas tut gayi) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Roke kulsum se fizza ne kaha shehzadi) x2 Teri chadar ka muhafiz bhi gaya
(Dono haatho se kamar thame huwe sheh ne kaha) x2 bujh gaya meri ummido ka diyya
<<MINI>>
(Aur pyaaso ki ye aas tut gayi) x2 Qatl darya pe alamdar huwa (Aur pyaaso ki ye aas tut gayi) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Alatash kehke jo rote the wo khamosh huwe) x2 Jaaye mahaar be matam ki fazaa
<<MINI>>
(Aur pyaaso ki ye aas tut gayi) x2 Qatl darya pe alamdar huwa (Aur pyaaso ki ye aas tut gayi) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Roye sadat to daryaa ka kanara roya) x2 Zindagi royi kahi(n) royi kazaa
<<MINI>>
